exposure: Prior cesarean section with placenta previa
cohort: The study included 372 pregnant women with placenta previa admitted to Baoji Maternal and Child Health Hospital between March 2022 and March 2024.
finding: Independent risk factors for postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) were identified as age >= 32.5 years, number of cesarean sections >= 2, placental adhesion, placental implantation, partial placenta previa, prior cesarean section with placenta previa, and anemia, with a dynamic nomogram model demonstrating excellent predictive performance for PPH risk.
mod_finding: A history of two or more cesarean sections and a prior cesarean section with placenta previa were identified as independent risk factors for postpartum hemorrhage.
